meta.title: Falling Back - 1
meta.description: Attack in unison, bringing down the stronghold together.

units.rawText: At the Oasis HQ.
units.displayText: At the Oasis HQ.

spans.text: At the Oasis HQ.

units.rawText: A report came in 3 minutes ago. The agents from the Cyclopes Sector have begun laying down suppressive fire on the Entropics.
units.displayText: A report came in 3 minutes ago. The agents from the Cyclopes Sector have begun laying down suppressive fire on the Entropics.

spans.text: A report came in 3 minutes ago. The agents from the Cyclopes Sector have begun laying down suppressive fire on the Entropics.

units.rawText: The Helios Sector has received support from Team Fern and the situation there is stable. Team Python has finished clearing out the enemy and is holding their position on the outskirts of the Enigma Sector.
units.displayText: The Helios Sector has received support from Team Fern and the situation there is stable. Team Python has finished clearing out the enemy and is holding their position on the outskirts of the Enigma Sector.

spans.text: The Helios Sector has received support from Team Fern and the situation there is stable. Team Python has finished clearing out the enemy and is holding their position on the outskirts of the Enigma Sector.

units.rawText: Also... the Sanctifiers are taking charge of the Pierides and Copley Sectors, and they are secure for now. Miss Meryl of the Burbank Sector will help us keep an eye on them.
units.displayText: Also... the Sanctifiers are taking charge of the Pierides and Copley Sectors, and they are secure for now. Miss Meryl of the Burbank Sector will help us keep an eye on them.

spans.text: Also... the Sanctifiers are taking charge of the Pierides and Copley Sectors, and they are secure for now. Miss Meryl of the Burbank Sector will help us keep an eye on them.

units.rawText: The Entropics that broke into Areas H, A, and B have been eliminated by Simo and his team. They don't need further reinforcements.
units.displayText: The Entropics that broke into Areas H, A, and B have been eliminated by Simo and his team. They don't need further reinforcements.

spans.text: The Entropics that broke into Areas H, A, and B have been eliminated by Simo and his team. They don't need further reinforcements.

units.rawText: Horizon has already moved out with her engineering unit. We estimate they'll be able to repair the firewalls in these three areas within 30 minutes.
units.displayText: Horizon has already moved out with her engineering unit. We estimate they'll be able to repair the firewalls in these three areas within 30 minutes.

spans.text: Horizon has already moved out with her engineering unit. We estimate they'll be able to repair the firewalls in these three areas within 30 minutes.

units.rawText: Thank goodness. Things are under control for now.
units.displayText: Thank goodness. Things are under control for now.

spans.text: Thank goodness. Things are under control for now.

units.rawText: But on the flipside, we're still under threat, and we only have one team to cover three areas.
units.displayText: But on the flipside, we're still under threat, and we only have one team to cover three areas.

spans.text: But on the flipside, we're still under threat, and we only have one team to cover three areas.

units.rawText: Now only Area G is still in danger... We've already sent Team Hubble over; is it still not enough?
units.displayText: Now only Area G is still in danger... We've already sent Team Hubble over; is it still not enough?

spans.text: Now only Area G is still in danger... We've already sent Team Hubble over; is it still not enough?

units.rawText: No, and Simo's heading there too. Area G's operand support has been dispatched, but...
units.displayText: No, and Simo's heading there too. Area G's operand support has been dispatched, but...

spans.text: No, and Simo's heading there too. Area G's operand support has been dispatched, but...

units.rawText: [Alert, Entropic virus incursion detected! Alert, Entropic virus incursion detected!]
units.displayText: [Alert, Entropic virus incursion detected! Alert, Entropic virus incursion detected!]

spans.text: [Alert, Entropic virus incursion detected! Alert, Entropic virus incursion detected!]

units.rawText: (Pants heavily) Are they... rushing to... their deaths?
units.displayText: (Pants heavily) Are they... rushing to... their deaths?

spans.text: (Pants heavily) Are they... rushing to... their deaths?

units.rawText: The firewall is almost completely destroyed!
units.displayText: The firewall is almost completely destroyed!

spans.text: The firewall is almost completely destroyed!

units.rawText: Prepare to fall back, Magnhilda!
units.displayText: Prepare to fall back, Magnhilda!

spans.text: Prepare to fall back, Magnhilda!

units.rawText: The only thing behind us is the Oasis... I can still hold out...
units.displayText: The only thing behind us is the Oasis... I can still hold out...

spans.text: The only thing behind us is the Oasis... I can still hold out...

units.rawText: This is no time to play hero!
units.displayText: This is no time to play hero!

spans.text: This is no time to play hero!

units.rawText: Crack.
units.displayText: Crack.

spans.text: Crack.

units.rawText: The wall is down!
units.displayText: The wall is down!

spans.text: The wall is down!

units.rawText: Did you hear that? Fall back already! Magnhilda!
units.displayText: Did you hear that? Fall back already! Magnhilda!

spans.text: Did you hear that? Fall back already! Magnhilda!

units.rawText: Vee? Wait, don't—
units.displayText: Vee? Wait, don't—

spans.text: Vee? Wait, don't—

units.rawText: Vee lunges at Magnhilda who's still on the frontline. At the same time, a bizarre beam of light suddenly fills the area they're in.
units.displayText: Vee lunges at Magnhilda who's still on the frontline. At the same time, a bizarre beam of light suddenly fills the area they're in.

spans.text: Vee lunges at Magnhilda who's still on the frontline. At the same time, a bizarre beam of light suddenly fills the area they're in.

units.rawText: Urgh...
units.displayText: Urgh...

spans.text: Urgh...

units.rawText: It's my optical camouflage. Don't move, they won't be able to see us for now.
units.displayText: It's my optical camouflage. Don't move, they won't be able to see us for now.

spans.text: It's my optical camouflage. Don't move, they won't be able to see us for now.

units.rawText: But the Oasis...
units.displayText: But the Oasis...

spans.text: But the Oasis...

units.rawText: I've sent people to evacuate the agents there and tear down the buildings so we can use them as makeshift bunkers.
units.displayText: I've sent people to evacuate the agents there and tear down the buildings so we can use them as makeshift bunkers.

spans.text: I've sent people to evacuate the agents there and tear down the buildings so we can use them as makeshift bunkers.

units.rawText: Really?
units.displayText: Really?

spans.text: Really?

units.rawText: Yup, you two go rest for a bit and let the Entropics go.
units.displayText: Yup, you two go rest for a bit and let the Entropics go.

spans.text: Yup, you two go rest for a bit and let the Entropics go.

units.rawText: After that, all the other units should fall back and prepare to surround them.
units.displayText: After that, all the other units should fall back and prepare to surround them.

spans.text: After that, all the other units should fall back and prepare to surround them.

units.rawText: We'll lock them in and release the hounds, nya~!
units.displayText: We'll lock them in and release the hounds, nya~!

spans.text: We'll lock them in and release the hounds, nya~!

units.rawText: Fight them if you have to, but cherish your dogs! They're innocent!
units.displayText: Fight them if you have to, but cherish your dogs! They're innocent!

spans.text: Fight them if you have to, but cherish your dogs! They're innocent!

units.rawText: Do whatever you want. I hate dogs!
units.displayText: Do whatever you want. I hate dogs!

spans.text: Do whatever you want. I hate dogs!

units.rawText: Hehe, don't argue. Everyone, please follow the shooting star as you fall back—
units.displayText: Hehe, don't argue. Everyone, please follow the shooting star as you fall back—

spans.text: Hehe, don't argue. Everyone, please follow the shooting star as you fall back—

units.rawText: Meanwhile, inside the firewall.
units.displayText: Meanwhile, inside the firewall.

spans.text: Meanwhile, inside the firewall.

units.rawText: Reporting, all units are in position.
units.displayText: Reporting, all units are in position.

spans.text: Reporting, all units are in position.

units.rawText: I can't wait to get stuck in!
units.displayText: I can't wait to get stuck in!

spans.text: I can't wait to get stuck in!

units.rawText: Mr. Aki, that outfit of yours is...
units.displayText: Mr. Aki, that outfit of yours is...

spans.text: Mr. Aki, that outfit of yours is...

units.rawText: Hm? You didn't know?
units.displayText: Hm? You didn't know?

spans.text: Hm? You didn't know?

units.rawText: I was having a bowl of gyutan-don while singing one of NotREAL's songs when someone blew all my clothes off.
units.displayText: I was having a bowl of gyutan-don while singing one of NotREAL's songs when someone blew all my clothes off.

spans.text: I was having a bowl of gyutan-don while singing one of NotREAL's songs when someone blew all my clothes off.

units.rawText: That's pretty bad...
units.displayText: That's pretty bad...

spans.text: That's pretty bad...

units.rawText: Which is why I'll wipe out all these Entropics if it's the last thing I do!
units.displayText: Which is why I'll wipe out all these Entropics if it's the last thing I do!

spans.text: Which is why I'll wipe out all these Entropics if it's the last thing I do!

units.rawText: ...You look too miserable like that. Here, put this on!
units.displayText: ...You look too miserable like that. Here, put this on!

spans.text: ...You look too miserable like that. Here, put this on!

units.rawText: What's this? It isn't time for a wooly jacket now, is it?
units.displayText: What's this? It isn't time for a wooly jacket now, is it?

spans.text: What's this? It isn't time for a wooly jacket now, is it?

units.rawText: People, the time for idle talk is over.
units.displayText: People, the time for idle talk is over.

spans.text: People, the time for idle talk is over.

units.rawText: Lam? How come you're on the frontlines too?
units.displayText: Lam? How come you're on the frontlines too?

spans.text: Lam? How come you're on the frontlines too?

units.rawText: Now isn't the time to consider efficiency. We should be thinking about how to survive.
units.displayText: Now isn't the time to consider efficiency. We should be thinking about how to survive.

spans.text: Now isn't the time to consider efficiency. We should be thinking about how to survive.

units.rawText: I'm so sorry for making you all fight while operands are in such short supply...
units.displayText: I'm so sorry for making you all fight while operands are in such short supply...

spans.text: I'm so sorry for making you all fight while operands are in such short supply...

units.rawText: No need to worry about that. Making full use of each operand is a sign of skill.
units.displayText: No need to worry about that. Making full use of each operand is a sign of skill.

spans.text: No need to worry about that. Making full use of each operand is a sign of skill.

units.rawText: ...Is that so? Thank you, Centaureissi.
units.displayText: ...Is that so? Thank you, Centaureissi.

spans.text: ...Is that so? Thank you, Centaureissi.

units.rawText: We only have just enough ammunition for everyone. Once Simo gives the signal, we'll all move in.
units.displayText: We only have just enough ammunition for everyone. Once Simo gives the signal, we'll all move in.

spans.text: We only have just enough ammunition for everyone. Once Simo gives the signal, we'll all move in.

units.rawText: As if in response to her statement, her communicator begins beeping.
units.displayText: As if in response to her statement, her communicator begins beeping.

spans.text: As if in response to her statement, her communicator begins beeping.

units.rawText: <size=40>Let's go! Vengeance for my gyutan-don!</size>
units.displayText: Let's go! Vengeance for my gyutan-don!

spans.text: Let's go! Vengeance for my gyutan-don!
